name: Redis Agent Memory
summary: Redis's managed memory layer for agents (part of Redis Iris): session memory with TTL plus long-term memory extracted in the background, via REST, MCP and SDKs.
description: Runs as a Redis Cloud service with Python and TypeScript SDKs and a REST API. The GitHub repo now holds a LongMemEval benchmark harness and the original open-source Agent Memory Server under `V0/`, kept as a research artifact rather than the supported production distribution.
